title: Rawlings Pro Preferred Fernando Tatis Jr. 12.75-inch Outfield Glove (Left-Hand Throw)
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match: ASIN B0H5XH5CFK is the Rawlings Pro Preferred Fernando Tatis Jr. 12.75-inch mint left-hand-throw outfield glove with a Pro H-Web, SKU PROSFTJ23-L.

comparisons.notes: Selected variant is THROWS LEFT, SKU PROSFTJ23-L, 12.75-inch Pro H-Web; one unit shown in stock. General product specifications also mention throws right, apparently reflecting the other variant.

writeup: Woot has a new Rawlings Pro Preferred Fernando Tatis Jr. 12.75-inch outfield glove in the mint left-hand-throw version, SKU PROSFTJ23-L, with a Pro H-Web, for $139.99.
